training_origins.step_reason: Every 14 days keeps each training origin on the same weekday as the backtest origins (which are 28 days apart, and so is the final origin d_1913), so horizon h always maps to the same weekday as in the forecasts being scored; 14 rather than 7 halves the table size.
training_origins.n_origins_reason: 26 x 14 days = one year of origins before each backtest origin, so every month, holiday and season appears once in the training targets; a second year doubles memory and run time for rows that are further from the forecast period.

f5_forecasts.residual: actual - forecast; actual NaN on unlisted days
